source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # A uniform center column separates two equally sized panels. The output
    # marks cells that are background in both panels.
    w = len(grid[0])
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    width = min(divider, w - divider - 1)
    return [[3 if row[j] == left_bg and row[divider + 1 + j] == right_bg else 5
